description: MiaAI-Lab TensorFold v0.6.0 with five patches for image/video input, YaRN, FP8 KV and pooled attention cache. Runs the creator-published ARM64 image tagged v0.6.0-fb91a0019fdc. Vontra MLX 4-bit target with z-lab DFlash2 drafter; eight streams and a 262,144-token window. KV caches grow on demand using upstream’s supported zero-pool mode instead of pinning its 78 GiB maximum at startup. The conservative 109 GiB memory envelope is retained; actual allocation depends on active requests. Physical Spark execution and model quality are unmeasured here.
title: Qwen3.8 27B TensorFold single Spark (Mia)
